APPENDIX I – GRIEVANCE FILING AND TIMELINE CHART

<table><tr><td>TYPE OF CASE</td><td>STEP 1</td><td>STEP 2</td><td>STEP 3</td><td>STEP 4</td></tr><tr><td>Letters of Reprimand and other grievances not listed below</td><td>Immediate excluded supervisor within 30 calendar days of the alleged violation* or receipt of the reprimand</td><td>University President or designee within 30 calendar days after the Step 1 response is due or received, whichever occurs first</td><td>USSE Director of Labor Relations within 30 calendar days after Step 2 response is received</td><td>Arbitration within 55 calendar days of receipt of Step 3 response by Union&#x27;s Legal Department</td></tr><tr><td>Discipline other than letters of reprimand and dismissal</td><td>File at Step 2</td><td>University President or designee within 30 calendar days of the effective date of the discipline</td><td>USSE Director of Labor Relations within 30 calendar days after Step 2 response is received</td><td>Arbitration within 55 calendar days of receipt of Step 3 response by Union&#x27;s Legal Department</td></tr><tr><td>Group grievances involving multiple supervisors in one university</td><td>File at Step 2</td><td>University President or designee within 30 calendar days of the alleged violation*</td><td>USSE Director of Labor Relations within 30 calendar days after Step 2 response is received</td><td>Arbitration within 55 calendar days of receipt of Step 3 response by Union&#x27;s Legal Department</td></tr><tr><td>Layoff and Recall</td><td>File at Step 2</td><td>University President or designee within 30 calendar days of the alleged violation *</td><td>USSE Director of Labor Relations within 30 calendar days after Step 2 response is received</td><td>Arbitration within 55 calendar days of receipt of Step 3 response by Union&#x27;s Legal Department</td></tr><tr><td>Family Medical Leave Act (FMLA) and Oregon Family Leave Act (OFLA)</td><td>File at Step 2</td><td>University President or designee within 30 calendar days of the alleged violation *; copy to OUS HR Division</td><td>FMLA - may be submitted to US DOL if unresolved OFLA – may be submitted to BOLI</td><td></td></tr><tr><td>Reclassification downward</td><td>File at Step 2</td><td>University President or designee within 30 calendar days of receipt of notice of reclassification downward</td><td>USSE Director of Labor Relations within 30 calendar days after Step 2 response is received</td><td>Arbitration within 55 calendar days of receipt of Step 3 response by Union&#x27;s Legal Department</td></tr><tr><td>Information Technology Competency Level</td><td>File at Step 2</td><td>University President or designee within 30 calendar days of receipt of denial of employee&#x27;s request to move to a higher competency level</td><td>USSE Director of Labor Relations within 30 calendar days after Step 2 response is received</td><td>Arbitration within 55 calendar days of receipt of Step 3 response by Union&#x27;s Legal Department</td></tr><tr><td>Grievances regarding temporary employees</td><td>File at Step 2</td><td>University President or designee within 30 calendar days of the alleged violation *</td><td>USSE Director of Labor Relations within 30 calendar days after Step 2 response is received</td><td>Arbitration within 55 calendar days of receipt of Step 3 response by Union&#x27;s Legal Department</td></tr><tr><td>Discrimination grievances</td><td>File at Step 2</td><td>University President or designee within 30 calendar days of the alleged violation*</td><td>EEOC/BOLI per applicable timelines</td><td></td></tr><tr><td>Dismissal</td><td>File at Step 3</td><td>File at Step 3</td><td>USSE Director of Labor Relations within 30 calendar days after the effective date of the dismissal</td><td>Arbitration within 20 calendar days of receipt of Step 3 response by Union&#x27;s Legal Department</td></tr><tr><td>Group grievances involving multiple universities</td><td>File at Step 3</td><td>File at Step 3</td><td>USSE Director of Labor Relations within 30 calendar days of the alleged violation *</td><td>Arbitration within 55 calendar days of receipt of Step 3 response by Union&#x27;s Legal Department</td></tr><tr><td>Denial of reclassification upward</td><td>File at Step 3</td><td>File at Step 3</td><td>USSE Director of Labor Relations within 30 calendar days of receipt of university/college denial of employee reclass request</td><td>Arbitration within 55 calendar days of receipt of Step 3 response by Union&#x27;s Legal Department</td></tr></table>

*The date the union or the grievant knew or by reasonable diligence should have known of the alleged grievance.

NOTE: If the deadline for filing or appealing a grievance falls on a Saturday or Sunday or university holiday, the deadline will be 5p.m. on the university next business day.
